starts without this one's messages.

on the last line of your reply:

 "content": "def transform(grid):
    """Connect diagonal 1 markers; a 6 on that segment emits its crossing diagonal."""
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    ones = [(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] == 1]
    # Connect any pair of 1 markers that lie on a 45-degree diagonal.
    connected = set()
    for i, (r1, c1) in enumerate(ones):
        for r2, c2 in ones[i + 1:]:
            if abs(r2 - r1) == abs(c2 - c1):
                n = abs(r2 - r1)
                dr = 0 if n == 0 else (1 if r2 > r1 else -1)
                dc = 0 if n == 0 else (1 if c2 > c1 else -1)
                line = [(r1 + k * dr, c1 + k * dc) for k in range(n + 1)]
                connected.update(line)
                for r, c in line:
                    if out[r][c] not in (6,):
                        out[r][c] = 1
    # Every 6 lying on a connected 1 segment draws its full perpendicular diagonal.
    seeds = [(r, c) for r, c in connected if grid[r][c] == 6]
    for r, c in seeds:
        # On a diagonal, perpendicular diagonal uses slope -1 (r+c constant).
        rr, cc = r, c
        while rr > 0 and cc < w - 1:
            rr -= 1
            cc += 1
        while rr < h and cc >= 0:
            out[rr][cc] = 6
            rr += 1
            cc -= 1
    return out
